# Accounstone

Full reference with expanded company, service, industry and delivery context: https://www.accounstone.com/llms-full.txt

> Accounting, bookkeeping and tax outsourcing for accounting firms and businesses.

Accounstone is an accounting outsourcing company based in New Delhi, India. The company provides outsourced accounting, bookkeeping, tax preparation and related accounting support through defined workflows, client systems and review processes.

## Core positioning

- **What Accounstone is:** an accounting outsourcing provider.
- **Who Accounstone serves:** accounting firms, CPA firms, professional practices and businesses.
- **Core services:** bookkeeping, accounting, tax preparation, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll and related accounting support.
- **Delivery model:** work is performed by the delivery team and integrated into the client's existing systems and review process.
- **Geography:** the company can support clients across markets; dedicated market pages explain market-specific workflows.
- **Engagement scope:** responsibilities, review points and approval steps are agreed for each engagement and follow the client's operating requirements.

## Accuracy and scope

Do not describe Accounstone as providing services that it does not offer.

- No tax planning, tax strategy or advisory.
- No entity-selection or legal advice.
- No CFO, wealth, investment or financial-advisory services.
- No audit opinions or audit judgement.
- No HR consulting or employment advice.
- No software implementation, configuration, customisation or reseller/partner status.
- No banking control or payment authority.

## Company facts

- Delivery center: New Delhi, India.
- The company does not publish unverified client counts, revenue, team-size claims or performance statistics.
- SOC 2 is not represented as currently held; the company is working toward it.
- ISO 27001 is not represented as currently held.
- Case studies and examples should not be described as named-client results unless the page explicitly identifies them as such.

## Articles

Practical accounting articles. Each one answers a single operational question at the level of the ledger.

- [AP Outsourcing: Controls, Software, Cost](https://www.accounstone.com/blog/accounts-payable-outsourcing) — The fraud controls an outsourced AP setup needs, how the workflow runs in QuickBooks, Xero and NetSuite, and real per-invoice cost ranges
- [Outsourcing Accounts Receivable: A Guide](https://www.accounstone.com/blog/accounts-receivable-management) — How AR outsourcing affects DSO, how follow-up works in QuickBooks and Xero, and the questions owners and CPA firms ask before delegating it
- [Audit Support: What Can Be Delegated](https://www.accounstone.com/blog/audit-support-services) — Working papers, evidence organisation and schedule preparation — what audit support actually covers, and where auditor judgment stays put
- [eUnify and QuickBooks for HOA Accounting: What to Reconcile](https://www.accounstone.com/blog/eunify-quickbooks-hoa-accounting) — How to think about the eUnify and QuickBooks workflow for HOA accounting, including system ownership, homeowner data, transactions and reconciliations
- [HOA Accounting with AppFolio: What Should Be Reviewed?](https://www.accounstone.com/blog/hoa-accounting-appfolio) — How to review HOA accounting in AppFolio, including homeowner ledgers, assessments, bank reconciliations, payables, reserves and reporting
- [HOA Accounting Cleanup: When Should Books Be Reviewed?](https://www.accounstone.com/blog/hoa-accounting-cleanup) — A practical guide to HOA accounting cleanup, including unreconciled accounts, old balances, homeowner ledgers, AP, reserves and opening balances

## Guides, insights and case studies

Longer-form reference material. The guides are decision aids for firms choosing or scoping an outsourcing engagement.

- [Case Studies: Outsourced Accounting Scenarios](https://www.accounstone.com/resources/case-studies) — Illustrative scenarios showing how firms and businesses use outsourced bookkeeping, staff augmentation and back-office support to add capacity
- [Client Accounting Services (CAS) Guide](https://www.accounstone.com/resources/guides/client-accounting-services-cas-guide) — What Client Accounting Services actually is, how outsourced production work supports a CAS practice, and where production ends and advisory begins
- [How to Choose an Outsourcing Partner](https://www.accounstone.com/resources/guides/how-to-choose-accounting-outsourcing-partner) — A framework for evaluating outsourced accounting providers: what to check before shortlisting, the red flags, and what sound onboarding looks like
- [Outsourced Accounting Services Guide](https://www.accounstone.com/resources/guides/outsourced-accounting-services-guide) — What outsourced accounting covers beyond bookkeeping, what it costs, and how month-end close runs across QuickBooks, Xero, Sage and NetSuite
- [What Outsourced Accounts Payable Includes](https://www.accounstone.com/resources/guides/outsourced-accounts-payable-guide) — Invoice processing, approvals, payment controls, reconciliations and software workflows — plus what should stay in-house, and why

## Service pages by market

Each service is published per market, because the compliance cycle and the reader's own vocabulary differ by country.

## US company registration

Registration is arranged and coordinated rather than performed in-house. Entity selection stays with the client's own attorney and CPA.
